Model, prompt and gateway changes are tested before merge (lines 1–4) and released as a canary that rolls itself back (lines 5–8). Real eval runs happen in one session cluster window, from the laptop; pull request checks only verify the committed results file. Nothing is public.

div.div: GKE: Google Kubernetes Engine. LiteLLM: the open-source LLM (large language model) gateway from P2. vLLM: the open-source model server from P1. TTFT: time to first token; p95: the 95th percentile. PR: pull request. L4: the NVIDIA GPU. BF16 / FP8: 16-bit and 8-bit model weights. Golden set: 100 test cases written and checked by hand. Judge: a model that scores open answers against a fixed rubric.
